summary:
Main
Domestic prices remained under pressure while some seaborne brand quotations stabilised. DCE mosttraded closed at 674.0 yuan/mt, down 0.44%, and all eight Qingdao products fell 2 yuan/wmt. The 61%, 58% and 65% port indices eased to 656, 617 and 820 yuan/wmt.
